accent.note: The one accent. Focus, caret, selection, active lens underline, slider fill, composer glow, working state. Never a resting button fill; only the send button turns ipê, on hover. Dark theme value #F2B53A.

accent-text.note: Ipê as text on a surface. Dark theme value #F2B53A.

accent-soft.note: Hover ground on nav rows and round tools, selection, working chip. Dark theme value #3A2E12.

mark.note: The mark and the 'nexus' half of the wordmark. Dark theme value #F2B53A.

canvas.note: Page ground and scope rail. The ramp runs through the dark and light neutrals of Grafite e Ipê.

surface.note: Cards, panels, top bar, inputs, composer. Dark theme value #16191C.

ink.note: Primary button fill. Dark theme value #EEF0F2, with on-ink #121518.

success.note: Always with a word. Dark theme value #6FD39A.

warning.note: Always with a word. Dark theme value #F5A25B.

danger.note: Always with a word and a round mark. Dark theme value #F28B9A.

display.purpose: Page titles and the home hero, in Bricolage Grotesque with balanced wrapping.

title.purpose: Section and card titles, in Bricolage Grotesque.

body.purpose: Everything read as language, in Hanken Grotesk.

fact.purpose: Model ids, paths, commands, times, durations, revisions, error codes and counts, in JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: A hovered project card, which also rises 2px.

shadows.name: row-lift
shadows.purpose: A hovered Workspace list row, which also rises 1px.

motion.name: ease-fit
motion.purpose: Encaixe while the agent works: the mark's pieces slide 2px apart and fit back, 1.2s, looping.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Encaixe on arrival (.9s, once per page load), arrivals rising 6px over .35s, card lift over .2s.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Color, background and border transitions on controls.

motion.name: composer-ring
motion.purpose: The conic ipê ring around the composer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition stops; the mark renders still.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The top bar drops the wordmark, the rail becomes a drawer, and Construir switches panes with a segmented control.

declaredDeviations.reason: The Preview shows the person's application edge to edge. Insetting it would put chrome between the person and the work.
The application rendered in the Preview is the person's own product, authored by the agent, and is not bound by this system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a surface. Ink, never ipê.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 .9rem; border: 1px solid var(--cx-ink); border-radius: var(--cx-radius-control); background: var(--cx-ink); color: var(--cx-on-ink); font: 500 .8125rem/1 var(--cx-font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cx-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Desconectar or Tentar de novo.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 .9rem; border: 1px solid var(--cx-line); border-radius: var(--cx-radius-control); background: var(--cx-surface); color: var(--cx-text); font: 500 .8125rem/1 var(--cx-font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--cx-surface-3); border-color: var(--cx-line-strong); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cx-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A single-line field with an ipê focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--cx-line); border-radius: var(--cx-radius-control); background: var(--cx-surface); color: var(--cx-text); font: 400 .875rem/1.4 var(--cx-font-body); transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--cx-text-2); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--cx-line-strong); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--cx-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cx-accent) 28%, transparent); }

components.name: Scope Rail Row
components.description: A 34px row in the left scope rail. Hover tints ipê soft; the active row is Surface Three.
components.html: Construir
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; height: 34px; padding: 0 .6rem; border-radius: var(--cx-radius-control); color: var(--cx-text-2); font: 500 14px/1 var(--cx-font-body); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--cx-accent-soft); color: var(--cx-text); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--cx-surface-3); color: var(--cx-text); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cx-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A status pill. Color always travels with a word, and a dot when live.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 .55rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cx-surface-3); color: var(--cx-text-2); font: 500 .75rem/1 var(--cx-font-body); } .ds-chip--live { color: var(--cx-success); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cx-success) 11%, var(--cx-surface)); } .ds-chip--live::before { content: ""; width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: A Project in the Workspace home grid. It lifts only on hover.
components.html:
Pedidos de férias

Alterado há 2 h
components.css: .ds-project-card { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 136px auto; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--cx-line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--cx-surface); color: var(--cx-text); text-decoration: none; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--cx-line-strong); box-shadow: 0 .6rem 1.6rem rgb(0 0 0 / .08); } .ds-thumb { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cx-line); background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 14px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cx-line) 45%, transparent) 14px 15px), var(--cx-surface-3); } .ds-project-body { display: grid; gap: .5rem; padding: .85rem 1rem 1rem; } .ds-project-body h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 1rem/1.3 var(--cx-font-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-project-body span { color: var(--cx-text-2); font-size: .8125rem; }

components.name: Lens Tabs
components.description: The Construir stage lenses. The active lens is 600 weight with a 2px ipê underline.
components.css: .ds-lenses { display: inline-flex; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-lenses button { padding: .5rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--cx-text-2); font: 500 .875rem/1 var(--cx-font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-lenses button:hover { color: var(--cx-text); } .ds-lenses button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--cx-text); border-bottom-color: var(--cx-accent); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Failure Note
components.description: A failure names the reason and what was preserved.
components.html: A última alteração não compilou. A prévia continua na versão anterior.
components.css: .ds-note { display: grid; gap: .5rem; padding: .75rem .9rem; border: 1px solid var(--cx-line); border-radius: var(--cx-radius-object); background: var(--cx-surface); color: var(--cx-text); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 var(--cx-font-body); } .ds-note p { margin: 0; } .ds-note--danger { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cx-danger) 35%, var(--cx-line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cx-danger) 7%, var(--cx-surface)); }

narrative.overview: Conexus is a governed enterprise workbench. A person describes the internal app they need in Portuguese, an agent builds it into a repository the company owns, and the app runs in the Preview. The interface is graphite: calm, flat, separated by hairlines, so that the person's own application is the most colorful thing on screen. Ipê, a warm gold, is the one accent. It marks focus, selection and the agent at work, and nothing else. Two readers share every screen: staff who are not technical, and the company's developers. The system serves both with one rule: prose in a sans face, facts in a mono face.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals with one warm accent, ipê.
Light and dark are both first class.
Prose is sans, facts are mono.
One authored motion, "Encaixe", and everything stops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ipê marks focus, selection, the active lens and the agent at work. It is never a resting button fill, a heading color or decoration. Only the composer's send button turns ipê, on hover.

rules.name: The Word Beside the Color Rule
rules.body: Color never carries meaning alone. Every status pairs a word with a mark, so it survives color blindness and a grayscale screenshot.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Light is the default and dark follows the operating system unless the person picks one. Neither is an afterthought: every change is checked in both.

rules.name: The Prose and Facts Rule
rules.body: Everything a person reads as language is sans. Everything that is a fact is mono. Mono is never a costume.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional prose never goes below 12px and mono stamps never below 11px. Numerals are tabular everywhere.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If a card needs a shadow to separate from its ground, the ground is wrong. Use the hairline.

dos: Do reach every color through a --cx-* token. npm run web:style:check fails on a raw hex outside tokens.css.
Do keep ipê for focus, selection, the active lens and the agent at work.
Do set every fact in JetBrains Mono and every sentence in Hanken Grotesk.
Do give every state a mark and a word.
Do keep the Preview edge to edge on white paper, the largest thing on screen.
Do check every change in light, in dark and under reduced motion.
Do write every string in pt-BR, sentence case, with verbs on buttons.
donts: Don't use ipê as a resting button fill or as decoration.
Don't use any font other than Bricolage Grotesque, Hanken Grotesk and JetBrains Mono.
Don't put a shadow on a card at rest.
Don't use violet or a purple-to-cyan gradient.
Don't use glass, a pulsing orb or a second authored animation. The composer glow is the only blur.
Don't reintroduce an address bar, a status strip under the application or a context chip above the composer.
Don't use monospace as a costume.
Don't invent customers, testimonials or metrics.
Don't show branches, pull requests or pipeline steps to the person.
